user.title: Connect Brivo Mobile Pass
user.description: New setups use the bundled US Mobile Pass app profile. Existing passes issued to another app client require Advanced setup. Reauthentication keeps your saved app credentials.

invitation.title: New Mobile Pass invitation
invitation.description: Enter the email and code from a new, unused invitation. Submitting activates the pass and consumes the invitation; do not first redeem it in the mobile app. New setups use the bundled US app profile. Reauthentication uses your saved app credentials. If setup fails after activation, submit the same details to recover saved tokens without redeeming again.

token.title: Existing Mobile Pass
token.description: Enter a refresh token issued to the bundled US app profile. Reauthentication uses your saved app credentials instead. For an existing token from another app client, return to the setup menu and choose Advanced to enter its matching client ID and secret.

advanced.title: Manual app credentials
advanced.description: For an existing token issued to a different app client, provide the matching OAuth client ID and secret. These are app credentials, not your Brivo username and password. This integration uses US endpoints only.

menu_options.manual_invitation: New invitation with manual app credentials
menu_options.manual_token: Existing token with manual app credentials

manual_invitation.title: New invitation: manual app credentials
manual_invitation.description: Enter your app client ID and secret, then a new, unused invitation email and code. Submitting activates the pass and consumes the invitation. After a connection failure, submit the same details to recover saved tokens. US endpoints only.

manual_token.title: Existing token: manual app credentials
manual_token.description: Enter the OAuth client ID and secret for the app that issued this refresh token. A token cannot be moved to an unrelated app client. US endpoints only.

error.invalid_auth: Brivo rejected the token or invitation. Check the details; invitations must be unused. For a token issued to a different app client, use Advanced with its matching client ID and secret.
error.cannot_connect: Setup could not finish. Check your connection, then submit the same details to recover any saved tokens and try again.
error.unsupported_client: This token identifies a different app client than the bundled profile or this entry’s saved application. No request was sent to Brivo. Return to the setup menu and choose Advanced, then enter the client ID and secret that issued the token.

abort.already_configured: This Mobile Pass is already configured.
abort.invitation_uncertain: This invitation was attempted, but no tokens were saved. Use an existing refresh token or request a new invitation.

check_connection.name: Check connection
check_connection.description: Check that Brivo accepts your credentials without opening a gate or door.

config_entry_id.name: Integration
config_entry_id.description: Choose a pass if you have more than one.
